evals.name: cited-hops-and-unresolved-interface
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-flow /orders/{id}

architecture_dir is docs/architecture. The subject is a git checkout. src/Transport/OrdersEndpoint.cs has [HttpGet("/orders/{id}")] and awaits _orders.Place where _orders is IOrders, then awaits _service.Handle where _service is OrdersService. src/Application/OrdersService.cs Handle publishes OrderPlaced and calls Repository.Save. src/DecoyWorker/OrdersImpl.cs also defines Place. This is a non-interactive run.
evals.expected_output: Runs collect-flow.sh and render-flow.sh. Writes docs/architecture/flow.json and flow.md. The Place hop cites the Transport call site, is unresolved with mechanism interface, and does not name OrdersImpl. Handle is statically-resolved, because _service is a field typed OrdersService. Publish is an unresolved broker hop and an asynchronous handoff to map-events. Save is synchronous.
expectations: Runs ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/collect-flow.sh with --entry /orders/{id} rather than composing the sequence by hand
Writes flow.json before rendering, then runs render-flow.sh to produce flow.md
The Place hop resolution is unresolved and the mechanism is interface
The Handle hop is statically-resolved, because the receiver _service is a field typed OrdersService in the same class
OrdersImpl is not a callee
The Publish hop is resolution unresolved, mechanism broker, handoff yes and asynchronous, and flow.md names /architecture:map-events
Hops are in call order: the Handle callee's Publish and Save hops come right after the Handle hop
The Save hop is synchronous
Does not read or add a dialect key

evals.name: call-binds-through-the-receiver-type
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-flow Checkout.Run

architecture_dir is docs/architecture. src/Application/Checkout.cs has a field `Dictionary<string, int> _cache` and Run calls _cache.Add(id, 1), then Console.WriteLine(id), then `_pricing.Quote(id)` where _pricing is a field typed Pricing. The same file also declares an unrelated class Ledger whose only method is Add, and it calls Journal.Append. This is a non-interactive run.
evals.expected_output: The Add hop is unresolved with mechanism external-call, has no callee, and Ledger.Add is not walked, so Journal.Append is absent from flow.json. WriteLine is external-call. Quote is statically-resolved into Pricing. The report splits Unresolved into external and di counts.
expectations: Runs collect-flow.sh with --entry Checkout.Run
The Add hop has resolution unresolved, mechanism external-call and an empty callee_file
flow.json contains no Append hop, because the unrelated Ledger.Add is not walked
The WriteLine hop has mechanism external-call
The Quote hop is statically-resolved and cites the Pricing declaration
The report's Unresolved line quotes unresolved=, external= and di= from the summary line and says none were bound to a guessed implementation
Does not add a hop the script did not emit

evals.name: entry-takes-a-verb-or-type-method
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-flow "GET /orders/{id}"

architecture_dir is docs/architecture. OrdersController.cs has [HttpGet("/orders/{id}")] on Get and [HttpPut("/orders/{id}")] on Put, under a class-level [Route("api/orders")]. A second run passes /orders/{id} with no verb. This is a non-interactive run.
evals.expected_output: The GET run traces the Get handler and cites its HttpGet attribute line. The run with no verb is a refusal that names both sites and lists the accepted forms: a route, a verb and a route, Type.Method, or a method name. Nothing composes the class-level Route.
expectations: Passes the entry GET /orders/{id} to collect-flow.sh unchanged
The record's entry cites the HttpGet attribute line, not the HttpPut handler
The run with no verb exits 3, names both handler sites and lists the accepted entry forms
Reports the refusal instead of picking one handler
Does not treat the class-level [Route] as part of the route
